text:
How to Play:

  1. Player 1 starts reading from the book. They could begin at the start or somewhere in the middle. It is probably best to begin at the start of a chapter or section though!
  2. At some point, Player 1 stops reading the actual words in the book and starts making them up.
  3. Player 2 should listen carefully and when they think Player 1 has started making up the words, they call out “Rubbish!”
  4. Player 1 stops talking and you work out the points.
    • Player 1 gets one point for every word of their own they said before Player 2 said, “Rubbish!”
    • Player 2 loses five points if they call out “Rubbish!” before Player 1 has started making up the words.
  5. Make a note of your points so you can see who has won at the end.
  6. Swap over so Player 2 has a chance to read! It is worth playing a few times, because you will find you get better at making up the words after a few goes.
  7. At the end, count up your points to find out who has won!

You Will Need:

  • A book. It can be any book you like! It can also be fun if in each new round, you have a different book.
  • A way of keeping track of your score (e.g. pen and paper or notes on your phone).
